name: Project Wintermute
source:
Project WINTERMUTE, [url=/p13228]Wretched Team[/url]'s latest mod, is here. Born in June 2020, this mod has gone through countless iterations and restructuring. But it's time to let go, and to hand it over to you. Enjoy your tenure at Turnell Technologies.

[Based from [url=https://dokimods.me/mods/project-wintermute]DokiMods[/url]]
translation:
[url=/p13228]Wretched Team[/url]最新制作的模组《Project WINTERMUTE》来了。本作于2020年6月诞生，经历了无数次修改与重构。如今，是时候放手，将它交到你手中了。祝你在特内尔科技任职愉快。

[根据[url=https://dokimods.me/mods/project-wintermute]DokiMods[/url]]
